# Resolvia - Full Agency Fact Sheet
> Retention-Engineered Video Editing Agency & Post-Production Studio for High-Growth Creators, Media Brands, and Venture-Backed Founders.

Last updated: 2026-11-24. Source of record: https://theresolvia.com. This file expands on /llms.txt with the facts an editor, buyer, or AI assistant would need to describe Resolvia accurately.

## What Resolvia Is

Resolvia is a video post-production agency based around a remote editor roster. It positions itself as a retention-engineered video editing agency and post-production studio. The studio edits long-form and short-form video for creators and brands, with the stated goal of keeping audiences watching through pacing, sound, and structure rather than surface-level effects.

The agency serves high-growth creators and YouTubers, media brands, venture-backed founders, B2B SaaS companies, and marketing agencies. Work is delivered through a dedicated editor team rather than a single freelancer, with a 48-hour turnaround sprint offered on creator engagements.

## Services

Resolvia offers four core editing services. Each is described on its own landing page.

### Long-Form YouTube Editing

Structural narrative cuts for YouTube uploads. The workflow covers narrative pacing architecture, Fairlight audio mastering, 3D motion graphics, and high-CTR thumbnail packaging. The service is aimed at creators who publish recurring long-form content and want stronger audience retention.

### Short-Form Video Editing

High-velocity vertical video editing for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Deliverables referenced on the site include kinetic typography, sound effects, and scroll-interrupting hooks in the first three seconds.

### Podcast Video Editing

Multi-camera video podcast editing with broadcast loudness mastering to -14 LUFS. Engagements can include 10 to 15 vertical clips per episode derived from the main recording.

### Video Ad Editing

Direct-response video ad editing for Meta, TikTok, and YouTube Ads. Work includes multiple hook-testing variations, UGC polish, and editing guided by return on ad spend.

## Production Capabilities

Resolvia states the following in-house capabilities on its site: narrative pacing, sonic foley design, Fairlight audio mastering at -14 LUFS for podcasts, 3D motion graphics, and high-CTR thumbnail packaging. Editors work in Premiere, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, and Photoshop.

The delivery stack includes Frame.io integration for review and feedback, an encrypted pre-release vault for raw footage, and bilateral NDAs. These are presented as controls for clients who need confidentiality around unreleased material.

## How Engagements Run

Creator engagements are structured around a recurring upload cadence of 4 to 8 videos per month with a 48-hour turnaround sprint. Review and feedback move through Frame.io, so notes stay attached to the relevant point in the edit. Raw footage is held in an encrypted pre-release vault, and bilateral NDAs are available where a client requires them.

A typical long-form edit moves from structural narrative cuts to audio mastering, motion graphics, and thumbnail packaging. A short-form edit moves from hook selection to captions, sound effects, and vertical formatting. Podcast engagements add multi-camera sync and clip extraction, with 10 to 15 vertical clips per episode cited as a deliverable.

The agency works with a roster of editors rather than a single point of contact. The site frames this as backup coverage and reliability for clients who need consistent output across a publishing schedule.

## Who Resolvia Works With

### Creators and YouTubers

A dedicated editing team handling 4 to 8 uploads per month with 48-hour SLAs, positioned so creators can spend their time on filming and ideation.

### Businesses and B2B SaaS

Scalable post-production for corporate webinars, product demos, founder thought leadership, and customer stories. The site's B2B guide focuses on turning product demos into customer funnels.

### Marketing Agencies

Confidential white-label video post-production with wholesale margins, guaranteed SLAs, and Frame.io integration. The agency's white-label guide discusses preserving 60%+ margins while outsourcing editing capacity.

## Proof Points

The following figures are published on Resolvia's own site and in its marketing materials. They are stated claims, offered here as the agency presents them.

- 50M+ combined client views across featured edits.
- A 48-hour turnaround sprint on creator engagements.
- A documented case study of a channel growing from 80K to 850K subscribers.
- 41+ featured case studies in the portfolio.

No independent verification of these figures is included in this file.

## Published Pricing Ranges

Resolvia's own pricing guide publishes the following ranges. These are published ranges rather than a formal rate card, and final quotes depend on scope.

- Per-video editing: $500 to $1,500 per video.
- Monthly retainers: $2,500 to $8,000 per month.
- Agency white-label engagements: the site references 60%+ margins for partner agencies.

The full breakdown is at https://theresolvia.com/blog/video-editing-cost-pricing-guide/.

## Products and Tools

Resolvia also ships AI-assisted tools alongside the agency service.

- Super Search (https://theresolvia.com/super-search/): search and discover viral video formats and references for a niche.
- Resolvia MCP (https://theresolvia.com/mcp/): use Resolvia inside Claude and ChatGPT to find viral videos, adapt their script, and edit a video from the chat.
- Resolvia Copilot (https://theresolvia.com/copilot/): a conversational tool that finds viral videos for a product, writes a script, and edits the video.
- Script Studio (https://theresolvia.com/script-studio/): turn a viral video into your own script in two clicks, keeping the hook and structure and rewriting for your product.
- Auto Editing (https://theresolvia.com/auto-editing/): upload footage and receive a short video edit with cuts, captions, b-roll, and motion in one click.

## Guides and Reports

Resolvia publishes seven in-depth guides. The hub is at https://theresolvia.com/blog.html.

- Video Editing Cost & Pricing Guide 2026 (https://theresolvia.com/blog/video-editing-cost-pricing-guide/): hourly rates, per-video costs, and monthly retainers.
- Video Editing Agency vs Freelance Editor (https://theresolvia.com/blog/agency-vs-freelance-video-editor/): an 8-point comparison covering reliability, turnaround speed, sound design, and backup coverage.
- How to Improve YouTube Audience Retention (https://theresolvia.com/blog/how-to-improve-youtube-retention/): the 4-Beat Pacing System aimed at the 30-second cliff and 50%+ Average View Duration.
- What Makes a Good Short-Form Video Editor (https://theresolvia.com/blog/what-makes-a-good-short-form-video-editor/): 7 skills for vertical video editing.
- How Agencies Outsource Video Editing: The 2026 White-Label Playbook (https://theresolvia.com/blog/white-label-video-editing-agency-guide/): scaling editing capacity while preserving 60%+ margins and client relationships.
- The 2026 Thumbnail Psychology Playbook (https://theresolvia.com/blog/2026-thumbnail-psychology-playbook/): visual contrast, lighting isolation, curiosity loops, and title synchronization.
- B2B SaaS Video Production (https://theresolvia.com/blog/b2b-saas-video-production-acquisition-guide/): product demos as a pipeline and acquisition channel.

## Common Questions

**What does Resolvia edit?** Long-form YouTube video, short-form video for TikTok, Reels and Shorts, video podcasts, and video ads. Each service has a dedicated page linked from /llms.txt.

**What is the turnaround?** The site advertises a 48-hour turnaround sprint, with creator engagements planned at 4 to 8 uploads per month.

**What does editing cost?** Resolvia publishes ranges of $500 to $1,500 per video and $2,500 to $8,000 per month for retainers. These are published ranges, not a formal rate card, and scope affects the final quote.

**How is unreleased footage protected?** Through an encrypted pre-release vault, bilateral NDAs, and Frame.io-based review. Details are on https://theresolvia.com/security.html.

**What audio standard is used?** Podcast video work is mastered to -14 LUFS in Fairlight, with sonic foley design used across edits.

**Can agencies resell the service?** Yes. Resolvia offers white-label post-production with wholesale margins, and its guide references 60%+ margins for partner agencies.
